prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached adult reference image as mandatory identity and environment source, create a balanced 2x2 grid of four photorealistic cinematic mid-close portraits. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, age presentation, hairstyle, clothing logic, and key traits in every panel. Use four dynamic wide-angle viewpoints from low, high, and oblique positions, but maintain natural anatomy and keep all body proportions realistic; use perspective to reveal the setting rather than to enlarge body parts near the lens. Expand the original environment conservatively with consistent materials, palette, and lighting logic across the grid. Use controlled cinematic contrast, crisp natural textures, and precise shared color grading. Preserve source text only if clearly present; otherwise add no text, logo, or watermark.
